news.title: How Troy Jackson went from Maine logger to the Democratic nominee for Senate against Susan Collins
news.description: Troy Jackson's path to politics started during his time as a logger in Maine's north woods. Now he's the Democrat challenging five-term Republican Susan Collins for a Senate seat that could determine control of the chamber in November. Jackson talks often about his ties to Aroostook County, a sprawling, wooded region known as “The County” to Mainers. It's where Jackson says he watched hard-working people struggle to get ahead. It’s also the place that sent Jackson to the Legislature while backing Republican Donald Trump for president. Jackson’s tiny hometown of Allagash is divided over his political ambitions. But he's leaning into his background to court rural voters and Maine’s many independents.
